title: Made by Designers
body:
This all is made by designers first and developers second. Entire app and their website feels like it’s made to show their design skills rather than being fast and functional.

UI is top notch but UX is bad, app has bugs. It is super slow (by design).

The App isn’t even getting past the lighthouse animation today, very frustrating.

Premise is good and graphics are amazing but I don’t want a dribbble, I want a working app.

author: Srinivas Damam

title: Most underrated app
body: I found this app through an Instagram ad and to be honest I was going to skip but that would’ve been a big mistake. I just started using the app so I don’t know how much impact it will have on me but I’m a person who has literally tried every single productivity app available on App Store and this one unlike others is so good because not only is it a habit tracker but it gives your articles about productivity and stuff and moreover there’s even a section for motivation. Literally you’ll have to download 3 different app for this experience. Moreover this app is clean and simple and of high standard and I really love that about this app. Usually either an app is useful but confusing or pretty simple but useless but this is so far perfect
